verdict.rationale: The Guichet unique docs recognise a third-party role: mandataires file large volumes of formalities (docs-12) and can delegate payment to their client (docs-13). They also state the signing requirement, an advanced e-signature on a qualified certificate (supp-1) or a FranceConnect+ login in its place (docs-15). That is only a glancing outline of delegated access, not a published scope of what a third party may and may not do. Missing for 10: published authorization/mandate forms (pouvoir), defined roles and permission boundaries for mandataires versus declarants, an explicit statement of which signatures must stay personal to the company representative, and any independent corroboration.
